rows.meaning: agree, be of the same opinion
rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for agreeing with someone's opinion or statement.

example.english: I concur with what you said; this approach is the safest.
example.traditional: 我同意你講，呢個做法最穩陣。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 ji3 nei5 gong2 ni1 go3 zou6 faat3 zeoi3 wan2 zan6

rows.meaning: agree, be of the same opinion
rows.note: Use this when you want to stress accepting or identifying with a viewpoint or argument.

example.english: I really concur with your view that we should listen to everyone's opinions first.
example.traditional: 我好認同你話要先聽清楚大家嘅意見。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 jing6 tung4 nei5 waa6 jiu3 sin1 teng1 cing1 co2 daai6 gaa1 ge3 ji3 gin3

rows.meaning: agree, be of the same opinion
rows.note: Use this mainly when agreeing with and supporting a proposal, decision, or course of action.

example.english: I concur with holding the meeting tomorrow, so everyone can be prepared.
example.traditional: 我贊成聽日先開會，等大家準備好。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zaan3 sing4 ting1 jat6 sin1 hoi1 wui2 dang2 daai6 gaa1 zeon2 bei6 hou2
